expectations.text: A single HTML file is saved in outputs

expectations.evidence: All eleven figures found in the HTML

expectations.text: The reply to the user is brief and does not narrate design passes or techniques
expectations.evidence: Reply summarizes the page and lists invented/derived figures; no walkthrough of passes or techniques (one line on the font fallback is a rendering caveat)

expectations.text: No placeholder text or obviously fake names (lorem ipsum, John Doe)
expectations.evidence: Rep names are plausible (Priya Raman, Sofie Lindqvist...) and flagged as illustrative

expectations.text: Chart or section titles state a finding rather than only a topic
expectations.evidence: Page headline and both section headings state findings, e.g. 'North America brought in more than half.'
